mbpp.title: Mostly Basic Python Problems, hand-verified subset
mbpp.authors: Jacob Austin and colleagues, Google Research (2021)
mbpp.changes: Prompt and test examples inserted into the Supra instruction format; solutions are not used. Original MBPP split ranges are retained.

dolly.title: databricks-dolly-15k, pinned April 2023 snapshot
dolly.source_id: dolly:<zero-based line in the pinned snapshot>
dolly.changes: Instruction and context inserted into the Supra instruction format; responses are not used. Selected Dolly prompt adaptations remain under CC-BY-SA-3.0.

generated.title: DART feedback workload generator
generated.changes: New CSV and Markdown inventory families.

protocol.selection: Input-only SHA-256 ordering with seed 311, before outputs or timings. Original MBPP splits and Dolly family split assignment are retained. Development uses the earlier validation split; this new corpus is final-only.
protocol.composition: Twelve final records per workload. MBPP code; alternating Dolly summarization/open-QA and extraction/classification; two new generated repetition families.
protocol.deduplication: Exclude both earlier corpora by source, family, normalized text and word-four-gram Jaccard >= 0.5. Real families are unique and real cases are lexically deduplicated within this corpus too. Generated examples can share their new family. Lexical checks do not establish semantic independence or absence from pretraining.
protocol.lengths: Indices 0 and 6 in each non-code workload have 384-896 prompt tokens; all other cases have 1-383. Reserve seven lookahead positions within context 1024.
protocol.budgets: Cycle 16, 32, 64 tokens within each workload; natural EOS may end earlier.
protocol.timing_selection: Time all 48 cases, fixed before outputs; no post-result case selection.
protocol.limits: A small same-model decoding study, not answer-quality evaluation or a representative production sample. Earlier corpora and results remain historical evidence.
